coco_wholebody.name: COCO-WholeBody v1.0 / COCO2017 images
coco_wholebody.annotation_license: CC-BY-4.0; upstream additionally limits the dataset to research and non-commercial use
coco_wholebody.authors: Sheng Jin, Lumin Xu, Jin Xu, Can Wang, Wentao Liu, Chen Qian, Wanli Ouyang and Ping Luo; annotations owned by SenseTime Research
coco_wholebody.citation: Jin et al. Whole-Body Human Pose Estimation in the Wild. ECCV 2020.
coco_wholebody.modifications: Keep the source's 133-label annotation indexing in prepared metadata, then select only the 73 declared body, finger, foot and face targets for model supervision. Person boxes are expanded by1.25 at width/height aspect0.75 and resized to256x192 RGB. Invalid annotations are excluded from2D loss. No duplicate hand-root outputs. Per-image license IDs and original source URLs are retained in dataset_manifest.json.
coco_wholebody.residual_calibration: CocoCalibrationDataset selects labeled crops only from COCOtrain using a deterministic hash. The deployed pose student's measured residuals inform3D input corruption. Validation and test examples are not used to fit the residual bank.

aspset510.name: ASPset-510 v1
aspset510.authors: Aiden Nibali, Joshua Millward, Zhen He and Stuart Morgan; La Trobe University and the Australian Institute of Sport
aspset510.citation: ASPset: An Outdoor Sports Pose Video Dataset With 3D Keypoint Annotations. Image and Vision Computing 2021, 104196. DOI:10.1016/j.imavis.2021.104196
aspset510.modifications: Select the 12 anatomical joints shared with COCO5..16; calibrated camera projection; camera-axis normalization; hip-midpoint subtraction; meters; frame subsampling. Expose these body12 labels in the shared73-point interface with all other2D/3D availability masks zero. Projected body bounding boxes use aspect0.75 and expansion1.25. No ASPset RGB video required.

h3wb.name: H3WB: Human3.6M 3D WholeBody annotations
h3wb.format: Inspected official NPZ contains only train_data and metadata object dictionaries, with no bbox dictionary. SHA256 is verified before object-array loading. Prepared worker NPZ files contain only numeric/string arrays and require no pickle.
h3wb.authors: Yue Zhu, Nermin Samet and David Picard
h3wb.citation: Zhu, Samet and Picard. H3WB: Human3.6M 3D WholeBody Dataset and Benchmark. ICCV2023, pages20166-20177.
h3wb.units: Raw camera_3d is in millimeters; divide by1000 and subtract the midpoint of COCOhips11/12 to obtain camera-space hip-relative meters.
h3wb.label_provenance: Author-released multiview reconstructed/completed whole-body3D labels. This is dataset supervision, not independently measured optical-marker ground truth for every finger or face landmark.
h3wb.bbox_source: The extent of all133 finite source2D landmarks, then aspect0.75 and expansion1.25. The official annotation-only NPZ does not include bounding boxes.
h3wb.modifications: Select the same compact73 anatomical labels used for2D. Transform source pixel pose_2d using its full133-point extent bbox and the common aspect/expansion rule. Preserve subject/action/camera and zero-padded source frame strings, separate2D/3D availability masks, sourceSHA256 and actual accepted sample counts. A subject and every camera view of its actions remain in one split.
h3wb.image_license: Human3.6M RGB images have separate terms; the MIT annotation license does not cover them. This data preparation downloads and distributes no Human3.6M images.

aspset_rgb_evaluation.name: ASPset-510 held-out RGB/body3D evaluation clip
aspset_rgb_evaluation.acquisition: Stream the official gzip tar from its beginning and stop after this first video member. Observed transfer was26,460,160bytes; code imposes a256MiB cap and never downloads the whole1.386GB video archive.
aspset_rgb_evaluation.subject: 1e28
aspset_rgb_evaluation.frame_alignment: C3D first_frame0,last_frame290 and17 joints in millimeters; officialbboxCSV has291rows. The official loader uses the same zero-based frame_index for mocap, bbox and decodedvideo.
aspset_rgb_evaluation.modifications: Select up to192evenlyspaced valid frames, decode actualRGB, crop from official annotatedpersonboxes using aspect0.75 and expansion1.25, resize256x192, convert body12 camera-space3D to hip-relative meters.
aspset_rgb_evaluation.scope: One held-out realRGB→body3D clip with ground-truth person crops. Person detection and whole-body hand/face/foot3D end-to-end accuracy are outside this metric.
aspset_rgb_evaluation.training_usage: Evaluation only. These test frames are not used for training, fitting or residual-noise calibration.
